name: Placard (Jogos Santa Casa)
verdict: Operated by Santa Casa da Misericordia de Lisboa, which runs Portugal's social games on behalf and on account of the State. Nothing found.
note: Portuguese state-linked fixed-odds sports betting product of Jogos Santa Casa; online licences held by SAS Apostas Sociais, Jogos e Apostas Online, S.A. (SRIJ). Main kit sponsor at Alverca, Moreirense and Vitoria SC in 2026-27. Rating note: the operator is state-linked ('on behalf and on account of the State'), but state ownership alone is not a tier; no record link found, so proposed none.
